prompt:
I filmed this object being moved. Write a URDF of it that I can load into MuJoCo to simulate it.

- Links: simple box or cylinder geometry, sized in metres to match the real object.
- Joints: the right type, axis, origin and limits, so the model moves the way the object moves in the video.

Make it as close to the real object as you can tell from the video. Reply with the complete URDF in one ```xml code block.
answer:
```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<robot name="laptop">
  <!-- base / keyboard chassis sitting on table -->
  <link name="base_link">
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.28 0.32 0.035"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="beige">
        <color rgba="0.82 0.80 0.74 1.0"/>
      </material>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.28 0.32 0.035"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="1.6"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.0138167" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="0.0106167" iyz="0" izz="0.0241067"/>
    </inertial>
  </link>

  <!-- display lid -->
  <link name="lid_link">
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0.14 0 0.0125" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.28 0.32 0.025"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="beige">
        <color rgba="0.82 0.80 0.74 1.0"/>
      </material>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0.14 0 0.0125" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.28 0.32 0.025"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0.14 0 0.0125" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="0.6"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.0051512" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="0.0039512" iyz="0" izz="0.00904"/>
    </inertial>
  </link>

  <!-- rear hinge: closed at 0, open ~90-105 deg -->
  <joint name="lid_hinge" type="revolute">
    <parent link="base_link"/>
    <child link="lid_link"/>
    <origin xyz="-0.14 0 0.0175" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="0 -1 0"/>
    <limit lower="0.0" upper="1.83" effort="5.0" velocity="2.0"/>
    <dynamics damping="0.15" friction="0.2"/>
  </joint>
</robot>
```
